Now that our Finite State Machine (the Orchestrator) is in place, it needs workers. The Specialists are C++ classes, each responsible for a single job.

## The Sensor Wrapper

To make adding future sensors trivial, we create a `SensorManager` wrapper. It contains a unified `SensorData` struct. If you want to add a UV sensor tomorrow, you simply add `float uvIndex;` to the struct, write a `UVSensor` class, and tell the `SensorManager` to read it. The FSM won't even notice the change!

```cpp
// Unified struct to hold all sensor readings
struct SensorData {
    String timestamp;
    float temperature;
    float humidity;
    float pressure;
    // Easy to add more fields here later (e.g., float uvIndex;)
};
```

## The SD Manager

Similarly, the `SDManager` class abstracts away all the file system mounting and power cycling logic. The FSM simply passes the populated `SensorData` struct to the `SDManager`, which handles the heavy lifting of appending to the CSV.

## Next Steps
With the sensors and SD card integrated into the FSM, we have successfully rebuilt Phase 1 and 2 in a modular way. Next, we will tackle the network logic.
